rationale: The agent appears to have identified the user and the correct order (tool calls include finding the user and checking both order IDs), and it processed a return for two items. However, it failed key policy requirements: (1) there is no evidence of explicit user confirmation before executing the order-changing write (return_delivered_order_items was called without prior confirmation shown), (2) it did not provide the total refund amount the user requested, only the timing and remaining-item totals, and (3) it did not clearly confirm which vacuum was being returned before acting. While refusal to expedite the refund is acceptable per policy, the lack of confirmation prior to the write and the missing refund total mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
